tldr: Venus through the 12th house softens rest, retreat, privacy, hidden pressure, and endings.
body:
When Venus moves through your 12th house, it draws your attention toward rest, retreat, privacy, hidden pressure, exhaustion, endings, and what you are not ready to explain. You may notice what is happening out of sight: fatigue, unfinished feelings, private pressure, or the need to step back before you can understand what comes next.

You may notice what feels wanted, valuable, pleasurable, attractive, or worth protecting. It can help you see what you actually want to choose, keep, enjoy, or repair.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for giving yourself space to process what cannot be solved by pushing harder.

The caution: Watch for choosing the pleasant answer because the honest one would ask more of you. The risk is disappearing into avoidance when what you really need is rest, honesty, and quiet support.

Venus moves through this house for a few weeks. Let ease show you what you value. Just do not confuse comfort with truth.
